name: fellow
description: Connect Fellow to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Fellow MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Fellow to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with meeting notes and actions using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Fellow workspace.
Find anything in Fellow that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review meeting notes and actions in Fellow.
